sections.title: From upstream 0.96.3
items: The critter that greets you in a fresh session now talks in chunky pixel art. Its speech bubble uses the same `m5x7` lettering and stepped tail as the `GG Royale` critters, and the critter stands at its true size with a shadow underneath instead of looking squished. Your Local Fork's starting tip and starter buttons still sit just below it.

Your built-in malware guard stays current on `Windows`. A quick refresh of the daily threat feed could leave GG holding the previous day's list, so a newly flagged package might slip through. GG now notices every refresh, so fresh warnings apply right away.
